doc: stages/writers.pcd.rst: 'X, Y, and Z dimensions will be written as single-precision floats by default to be compatible with most of the existing PCL point types.' The FIELDS assertion grades the dimension names the `order` option asks for, and their order, not their casing: no agent-visible document states a casing rule for PCD field names -- the only statement anywhere is `development/release-notes/2.1.0.md` ('writers.pcd now always writes dimension names as lowercase'), and PROFILE 1.3, carried into 3.3, declares everything under `development/` background that 'raise[s] no scored requirement of [its] own'. `FIELDS X Y Z Intensity GpsTime` therefore conforms as much as the lowercase spelling.
